scientific_boundary: The atlas is an exact typed synthesis and finite necessity/nonselection control. It does not establish a computational ontology, four fundamental degrees, a selected view family, a selected metric, new dynamics, or empirical excess.

fields.selection_status: must be frozen or physically selected
does not by itself supply time or metric

mathematical_correction.four_degrees: A four-dimensional carrier is a conditional finite specimen, not an earned spacetime or substrate claim.
mathematical_correction.metric: A metric is a section of Sym^2(T*M), not itself the carrier bundle.
mathematical_correction.connection: A connection supplies transport and comparison across base points; it is not supplied by a metric in every admitted theory.
mathematical_correction.projectors: View projectors select components or quotients but are not generally rulers and are not selected merely by writing them down.
mathematical_correction.action: An action functional constrains dynamics; it is not an interaction between coordinate labels.

views.formal_type: history/process quotient or formed carrier map
views.relation_to_common_object: a sufficient quotient only relative to a frozen query/action family
Galois-dual to an exact operational record requirement

views.formal_type: copy/compare/merge congruence on a selected interface
views.relation_to_common_object: restricts which quotients remain lawful under composition

views.formal_type: action-safe closure over incompatible continuations under a fault/provenance contract
views.relation_to_common_object: orders closed capability-record pairs but is not generally a scalar chain

views.formal_type: held-out causal/conformal/metric target reconstructed from response relations and rulers
views.relation_to_common_object: downstream of capability saturation and an independent scale-bearing mark

relationship_results.statement: A family of views reconstructs a target exactly iff the intersection of its equivalence kernels refines the target kernel.
Record requirements and capability queries form an antitone Galois connection after the query family is frozen.
Composability and finality add congruence, access, fault, provenance, and action-safety conditions; they are not new coordinates of the carrier.
Even a jointly state-separating view family does not select a metric completion when the ruler response is absent.
relationship_results.novelty: finite specialization of HC-DU-112 and inverse-problem nonidentifiability

relationship_results.statement: Matched re-encoding of carrier and all view maps may be gauge; changing only a projector, ruler, or consumer is generally physical.

extra_axiom.name: physically selected common-view closure
extra_axiom.statement: One target-independent physical antecedent selects the process boundary, action/resource envelope, perspective maps, their matched representation orbit, and enough ruler response that the joint view diagram commutes and is faithful up to declared gauge.
extra_axiom.why_nontrivial: A complete process can admit many inequivalent instruments, observers, consumers, quotients, and metrics. Adding them as tuple fields is representation, not selection.
extra_axiom.theorem_obligation: Either construct a physically selected natural family satisfying joint descent and target reconstruction, or exhibit the smallest symmetry, contextuality, consumer-freedom, or metric ambiguity obstruction.
extra_axiom.falsifier: Two equally admitted antecedent completions have identical selected process and all formed view data but incompatible view relations or held-out ruler/metric responses.
extra_axiom.retreat_cost: Without CVC-A the computation-first picture remains a useful compatibility atlas only.

exact_controls.two_qubit_pauli_transfer: the same fifteen nonzero linear response functionals arise as Pauli commutation testers

next_action.question: Does one physical antecedent select a natural matched family of record, capability, composability, finality, and ruler maps, or what is the smallest exact obstruction?
